about_short_description.short_description: Fly.io provides a cloud platform for deploying, running, and scaling applications, databases, and AI workloads globally.

product.name: Fly Machines
product.description: Hardware-virtualized containers with a REST API that run any Docker image on a global cloud across 35 regions, scalable from single HTTP requests to long uptime.

product.name: User-Specific Routing
product.description: Dynamic request routing that directs each user or robot to their own dedicated sandbox using Fly Proxy and fly-replay.

product.name: Persistent Storage
product.description: Dedicated storage solutions for users or robots including Fly Volumes, Fly Managed Postgres, and S3-compatible Tigris Data.

product.name: MCP Servers
product.description: Remote Model Context Protocol servers built on Fly Machines to integrate sandboxes into large language model workflows.

product.name: Developer Support Packages
product.description: Paid support services offering access to engineers who use the platform, including emergency support and guaranteed response times.
